Mo & Krill.why: Default sustained front line the new economy keeps handing him — Scorn/Burrow uptime and T3 bullet resist make him one of the few tanks who can still commit under a Guardian, though objective parries no longer reset, trimming the free dive chain he leaned on. Ranged poke he cannot close on (Celeste, Vindicta) and rising Paige still beat him.
Mo & Krill.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; the Haunt-camp/hub economy keeps him the default sustained front line, but objective parries no longer reset — the free dive chain is trimmed. Ranged poke (Celeste, Vindicta) and rising Paige still beat him.
City Never Sleeps: camp/uptime meta plus Billy's slide hand him the default sustained front-line slot.
Data: spirit core confirmed (Mystic Burst 100%, Torment Pulse 91%); ~40% PR is high, not a WR outlier.

Shiv.why: Anti-tank the rising frontline feeds — current-HP Serrated Knives shred Abrams/Mo & Krill/Billy and his regen stack loves the harder Haunt camps — but burst/hook CC (Yamato, Drifter, Bebop) kills him before regen ramps, and a 43.4% snapshot WR keeps this a directional read.
Shiv.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; harder Haunt camps reward his regen stack and the rising frontline feeds Serrated Knives, but a 43.4% snapshot WR keeps this soft.
City Never Sleeps: rising anti-tank — the bigger front line feeds current-HP Serrated Knives and harder camps reward his regen.
10-14: Radiant Regeneration spirit scaling 0.04->0.035 chips his near-universal regen core; kit untouched.

Warden.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct line; contested Soul Bags and earlier Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza objectives close games even faster, deepening the wait a late gun scaler cannot afford — no core item moved.
City Never Sleeps: no direct line; the no-comeback farm-route economy refuses to wait for him and Shadow Weave gains little from the layout.
09-16: bullet dmg/boon, flask range/speed, Willpower T3 cut; Mercurial Magnum + Spiritual Overflow nerfed, Veil Walker stripped.

Yamato.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; punch AoE is still the fastest clear for the new grouped, behavior-varied Haunt camps and Flying Strike paths open the separated Shrine/objective layout.
City Never Sleeps: Flying Strike creates paths against solid targets (turrets, Shrines, objectives) — new mobility/objective access — and she was the camp-clear champion vs grouped camps.
Tankbuster is a 39% late luxury (25m avg buy); the Refresher build stays niche/creator-driven.

Lash.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; new districts/Steam Vents extend his dive routes and the green-lane roof/tree keeps permanent lane high ground — still S.
City Never Sleeps: no direct line; the green-lane roof/tree gives permanent lane high ground and boxes matter more to his farm.
09-16: Ground Strike T3 scaling + per-meter damage up, gun falloff changed, Flog heal nerfed.

Mirage.why: Split-push hybrid the tempo economy buries: contested Soul Bags and earlier hub objectives make his slow scaling and map-play rarely come online, and rising Mo & Krill/Lash dive him off his map-play. Kit intact — beaten by the meta, not the notes.
Mirage.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; contested Soul Bags and earlier hub objectives worsen a slow split-pusher, and rising M&K/Lash dive him off his map-play — beaten by the meta, not the notes.
City Never Sleeps: no direct line; comeback souls gutted and early Rift is now a real fight, so his map-play rarely comes online; Toxic Bullets scaling buff is a small offset.
10-05: trooper-speed fix restores intended wave pathing so his split-push converts on schedule (tiny QoL).

Drifter.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; new districts, Steam Vents and heavy-melee Tough-Crate routes fit his stealth-reveal roam (peercontent, unverified); Celeste falling softens one lane, but rising Dynamo/M&K/Apollo worsen others — net stable.
09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; new districts/Steam Vents and heavy-melee Tough-Crate routes fit his roam.
Dropped KB core_items Decay/Toxic Bullets/Fortitude — none in current 30-day usage; the 'Toxic Bullets bot' framing is a 2026-04 artifact.

Victor.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; harder Haunt camps and longer PvE routes feed his regen stack, keeping him A on a 56.4% snapshot WR (board's second-highest) — anti-heal and burst are still his off-switch.
09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; hard Haunt camps fed his sustain stack, flipping him from fair B-baseline to A on the 56.4% snapshot WR.
Data disagrees with the 07-16 creator read: Refresher/Echo Shard appear in none of his top-15 buys — his real build is spirit sustain.

Paige.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks reward her lane pressure and the contested hubs suit her carry-snowball — still S.
City Never Sleeps: no direct change; lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks reward her lane pressure, and the contested hubs suit her carry-snowball.
09-16: heavy-melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read T1 -11->-14s / T3 +1m->+2m; Slowing Hex cd 27->29s a minor tax.

The Doorman.notes:
Paint the Town: no direct change; Bell Tower's single rope and ~280-soul payout give his Doorway a real kidnap objective play, but tempo dive (Yamato, Lash, Apollo, Holliday) still beats his setup.
City Never Sleeps: no direct change; Bell Tower's single rope + ~280 souls makes his Doorway kidnap a real objective play (pre-place door before roping up).
09-16: no direct line; loses his Veil Walker disengage (Sprint Boots + movespeed-on-break removed).
